name: Robert Miller
clinical_narrative: 68-year-old male with longstanding Type 2 Diabetes presenting with progressive bilateral lower extremity edema, worsening fatigue, polydipsia, and marked nocturia. Labs reveal eGFR 22 mL/min/1.73m2 (KDIGO Stage 4) and HbA1c 9.2% reflecting uncontrolled hyperglycemia.

name: Eleanor Vance
clinical_narrative: 72-year-old female presenting with severe lethargy, uremic pruritus, anorexia, and morning occipital headaches. Renal panel demonstrates advanced renal failure with eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73m2 (KDIGO Stage 5 / Kidney Failure) alongside Stage 2 Essential Hypertension (165/95 mmHg). Normal glycemic profile.

name: David Chen
clinical_narrative: 54-year-old male presenting for initial glycemic management. Patient reports mild fatigue and thirst. Renal function is well preserved with eGFR 88 mL/min/1.73m2. HbA1c is 8.4%. Normotensive without peripheral edema.

name: Margaret Thorne
clinical_narrative: 61-year-old female with persistent Stage 2 Essential Hypertension (152/94 mmHg) and occasional occipital headaches. Renal biomarkers are stable with eGFR 78 mL/min/1.73m2 and normal fasting glucose.

name: Arthur Pendelton
clinical_narrative: 65-year-old male presenting with triple cardiometabolic multimorbidity: uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes (HbA1c 9.8%), severe Stage 2 Hypertension (160/98 mmHg), and advanced CKD Stage 4 (eGFR 18 mL/min/1.73m2) with dependent pedal edema.

name: Martha Jenkins
clinical_narrative: 64-year-old female with isolated Stage 4 Chronic Kidney Disease (eGFR 21 mL/min/1.73m2), generalized pruritus, nocturia, and fatigue. Glycemic indices and systemic blood pressure are within acceptable parameters.

name: Leo Martinez (Pediatric)
clinical_narrative: 14-year-old adolescent male with early-onset Type 1 Diabetes presenting with persistent microalbuminuria and declining renal function (bedside Schwartz eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73m2). Uncontrolled HbA1c 9.4%. Requires pediatric basal-bolus insulin optimization; all unapproved adult oral agents contraindicated.
